estimand: E = N_direct - N_all; I = E_staggered - E_aligned, spikes per 500 ms
checks: All 30 cell measurements were independently recounted from saved raw arrays before reading the original analysis, then reconciled exactly with the recorded outputs.
All 10 paired comparisons and five signed timing interactions reconcile exactly; I is shifted minus aligned, in spikes per 500 ms.
Source neuron identities and direct/all-output connection masks were independently reconstructed from the pinned source data.
Every schedule has 50 candidate pulses per GRN per period. Applied pulse arrays and actual GRN spike trains are identical across the three interventions within each template/timing triplet.
Frozen source hashes, schedule repetition, selected-neuron records and window conventions were checked. The full-network candidate/reference replay gate passed before the grid.
Within each template, applied-event and actual GRN spike count vectors also match across timing patterns in both the middle window and whole run; their spike timings differ.
limits: Five artificial input templates, one fixed model gain and one 500 ms measurement window are descriptive evidence; they do not establish significance, generalisation to natural input or an absence of effects.

Scheduled candidate pulses are not guaranteed applied pulses or emitted spikes. Individual GRNs produced 49–50 middle-window spikes; matching scheduled counts does not match sensory spike trains across timing patterns.
Retiming changes population coincidence and the population input envelope together; this is not an isolated test of biological synchrony.
A fixed 500 ms warmup is not a demonstration of steady state. The model does not validate a biological mechanism, body movement or a mediated fraction.

Raw runtime synaptic weight vectors and complete restored initial-state arrays were not exported; checks for these rely on source masks and recorded hashes/assertions. Full saved output arrays remain local.
The source archive is for inspection. Exact upstream data are separate; dated execution guards and environment constraints require the documented reproduction steps.
E is a signed comparison between two interventions, not an isolated contribution of indirect pathways.
primary_archive: Full per-cell NPZ files retained locally; selected spike export allows recounting primary MN9 outcomes.
